title: Line 216: broad `except Exception` (BLE001)
detail: Catching `Exception` at line 216 prevents distinguishing expected errors from unexpected failures. Fix: catch specific exception types, or re-raise after logging if a broad catch is intentional.

title: too-many-branches (R0912) — function(s) at line 267
detail: A function has more branches than pylint's threshold. High branch count multiplies test cases needed for coverage and makes the function a defect magnet. Fix: extract decision clusters into named helper functions.
